description: The MultiSpectral Instrument (MSI) on Sentinel-2A, a 13-band imager from 443 to 2190 nm (bands B01-B12 and B8A). The curves are ESA's band-averaged spectral responses for Sentinel-2A from the Sentinel-2 Spectral Response Functions workbook (COPE-GSEG-EOPG-TN-15-0007, v5.0), measured on the ground during the MSI assembly, integration and test campaign; each is the whole-instrument band response, peak 1.
facility_description: Sentinel-2 is ESA's optical high-resolution Earth-observation mission for the Copernicus (formerly GMES) programme; Sentinel-2A, -2B and -2C each carry an MSI.

notes: Published 2026-10-26 under Nill's hosting decision (built with FX_MSI_PUBLISH=1). The SRF workbook is a SentiWiki attachment; SentiWiki's terms (https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/terms-and-conditions) do not grant redistribution or derivative works without prior written authorisation, and the workbook itself carries no licence statement. The Copernicus Sentinel data licence (https://ads.atmosphere.copernicus.eu/licences/ec-sentinel: 'EU law grants free access to Copernicus Sentinel Data and Service Information for the purpose of the following use ... b. distribution') would allow redistribution with the notice 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [Year]' if ESA confirms the SRFs count as Sentinel data; that is not stated anywhere seen. Description paraphrases the workbook Overview sheet: 'This spreadsheet contains the measured spectral responses for each band of Sentinel-2A and Sentinel-2B MultiSpectral Instrument (MSI).' (the text predates S2C; S2C sheet added in v4.0), 'The values in the SR_AV_Bx columns represent the average spectral response determined through ground-based testing of the MSI' and 'Data are based on ground measurements performed in the frame of the Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) campaign of the MSI.' Sentinel-2A averages taken from Synthèse_moyennes_donnees_spectrales.xlsx (worksheet "S2A_NEW") (Overview sheet). Band range 443-2190 nm from the workbook Overview band table centre wavelengths (B01 to B12). Facility text from the title of doi:10.1016/j.rse.2011.11.026 ('Sentinel-2: ESA's Optical High-Resolution Mission for GMES Operational Services') and the workbook sheets for S2A/S2B/S2C. Photon/energy weighting is not stated by the owner; DetectorType=energy is tagged 'assumed'. Pivots agree with ESA's 'Equivalent Wavelengths' sheet (int(lambda S)/int(S)) to <=0.25 %. Naming: Facility 'Sentinel' as in SVO's Sentinel/MSI IDs; SVO's MSI.Bxx-A/-B suffixes are likely S2A/S2B but no archived SVO record was available to confirm, so instruments use the owner's satellite names.
